entries.name: Interpreter trace loop
entries.boundary: global I check plus per-trace busy/Preserve/Release and step ordering

entries.name: Old native callback route

entries.name: Step creation
entries.boundary: call==0 and post-restore step setup retain lifecycle obligations

entries.name: Private stub ingress
entries.boundary: actual loaded/private clients and images unqualified

entries.name: Nested direct invocation
entries.boundary: no global direct-route I check; nested I must restore to prior one

entries.name: Removal/destruction
entries.path: busy tcmdPtr zero flags; active cursor updates; final refs
entries.boundary: unlink or busy-clear is not actual native return

entries.name: Result state cleanup
